name: Hymn of Dissonance
body:
School enchantment [evil, mind-affecting]; Level bard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 40 ft.

Target radius burst centered on you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Each creature within the area who is not already taking an action to physically attack a creature during their turn must make a Will save. On a failure, they must physically attack the nearest creature, whether enemy or ally. This will include moving up to their normal movement to do so. If they are unable to attack during the turn due to no targets nearby, they are nauseated for 1 round. You are not affected by the song.
